[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]no user-facing capability silently dropped on the way.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Restore forced name reuse on the durable launch path[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]force_reuse[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]force_reuse: extract the `%id:!name` force-reuse launch pipeline out of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the orphaned TUI body into a shared `sase.agent.force_reuse_launch` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]module, carry ACE's confirmation through the `RUN_LAUNCH` request [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]payload, and consume it in the `sase run` child so kill-and-edit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]relaunches work again before the orphaned copy is deleted.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Restore MRU and unresolved-reference feedback on the durable [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]launch path[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]feedback[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]feedback: move VCS-xprompt MRU recording and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unresolved-xprompt-reference warning toast onto the durable path, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`<ctrl+p>` cycling keeps being fed and ACE keeps warning about unknown [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`#refs` once the orphaned body is deleted.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Retire the cleanup worker bodies and their proc_callable seam[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cleanup_retire[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cleanup_retire: delete the dead `_worker` closures behind kill, dismiss,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and save persistence, drop `proc_callable` from `_submit_cleanup_proc`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and re-point the shared cleanup test harness at the durable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]persist-cleanup payload seam.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Retire the in-process launch body and fan-out dispatchers[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]launch_retire[dim] · [dim][/dim]after force_reuse, feedback[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]launch_retire: delete `run_agent_launch_body`, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`run_single_agent_launch_body`, the four fan-out dispatcher mixins, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`proc_callable` on `_submit_launch_proc`, then delete or re-point every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]test that reached them through the discarded callable.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Retire the launch-body support modules the deletion orphans[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]support_retire[dim] · [dim][/dim]after launch_retire[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]support_retire: delete the second-order orphans the body deletion leaves[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]behind — the background-spawn bridge, launch-history helpers, TUI [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workflow executor, and the ref-resolution mixin — resolving each against[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]symvision rather than by assumption.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Final orphan sweep, full verification, and follow-ups[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]sweep[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cleanup_retire, support_retire[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sweep: re-run the whole-repo lint and full test suite, resolve any [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]remaining orphan reported by symvision, and file the follow-up beads for[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the capabilities this epic deliberately leaves broken rather than [/#D7D7AF]
